Good morning, everybody, this is your first officer speaking. We have started our descent into Perth and we will be on the ground in about twenty five minutes. Before we land, please fill in the card the crew gave you earlier. Australia is very strict about food, so read question nine slowly. Do you have any food, plants or animal products with you? If you do, write yes. Nobody gets in trouble for writing yes. People get in trouble for writing no when the answer is yes. And if you are not sure about something in your bag, write yes and ask an officer inside. Local time in Perth is six forty in the morning and it is already twenty two degrees. Welcome to Western Australia.

Morning. Passport, thanks. Where have you come from today? Brazil, all right. And how long are you staying in Australia? Six months. What are you doing here for six months, then? An exchange program, okay. Which school is that? And who are you staying with, a host family? Do you have their address on your phone? Good, that is all I need. Just two more. Did you pack this bag yourself? And is there anything in there that is not yours? Any food at all? Right. Look at the camera for me, and no smiling. That is you done. Enjoy your six months.
